notes:
Bitify 1.7.4

The app carries the product's name now, all the way down: the package is com.bitify.music, the party links say bitify:// instead of the old name, and the server calls itself bitify-listen-together. A link shared before the rename still opens the app.

Also in this release:
- The update feed names the build for each kind of processor now, and the phone takes the one that fits it: about 71 MB instead of 172 MB. On a phone that difference is the difference between an update and a download that never finishes.
- The listening minutes, the streak and the leaderboard keep working the way they did: they live with your account, the server keeps them in the database instead of on a disk that a release wipes, and one listener is one row on the board.
- The privacy policy, the terms and the security page now write to you directly.
